name: interior-specifics/method-journey
title: Method Journey
description: The Interior Specifics Method™ as scroll-driven storytelling: on desktop the section pins while each act cross-fades in; on phones and with reduced motion the acts stack as full-bleed panels.

title.default: Our Proven Process for Creating Exceptional Spaces

intro.default: Five deliberate acts that turn ambition into a space you'll love for years.

default.title: Discover
default.detail: Deep-dive consultation, lifestyle audit and vision mapping.
default.narrative: Every project begins with you. We listen, audit how you live and work, and map a vision worthy of your space.

default.title: Design
default.detail: Concept development, 3D renderings and material selection.
default.narrative: Your vision becomes tangible — concepts, photoreal renders and curated materials you can see and feel before a single decision is final.

default.title: Source
default.detail: Curated furniture, artisan partnerships and global procurement.
default.narrative: We reach the furniture houses, artisans and ateliers most never access — sourcing, negotiating and managing every piece to your scheme.

default.title: Execute
default.detail: Project management, quality control and timeline adherence.
default.narrative: We orchestrate trades, deliveries, budgets and quality — a single point of accountability so the build runs flawlessly while you simply wait.

default.title: Reveal
default.detail: Final styling, walkthrough and lifetime support.
default.narrative: The doors open on a space that honours your journey — styled to the last detail, with our care continuing long after the reveal.
